title: 类初始化顺序：父类静态 → 子类静态 → 父类实例 → 子类实例
expected_output:
=== 1st new Child() ===
    Parent.static.field
    Parent.static.block
    Child.static.field
    Child.static.block
    Parent.instance.field
    Parent.instance.block
    Parent.<init>
    Child.instance.field
    Child.instance.block
    Child.<init>
=== 2nd new Child() : statics run only once ===
    Parent.instance.field
    Parent.instance.block
    Parent.<init>
    Child.instance.field
    Child.instance.block
    Child.<init>
=== compile-time constant access ===
    Const.C = 42  (no <clinit> line above => constant folded)
